messages.subject: gl2gds and gl2plink is not working when i added chromosome and its position; while its working well without it.
parts:
Dear Arthur and all,
I need quick help on how to convert from gl2gds or plink with chromosome and position information. I tried it but getting following error which looks error due to sort genotype option. Could you suggest to me how can I convert it successfully without the following error?
I think chromosome and position information is also important when you do LD analsyis and GWAS.

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: gl2gds and gl2plink is not working when i added chromosome and its position; while its working well without it.
parts:
Hi Rajneesh,

It seems that the function requires that loci are ordered by position. Can you try the following code.

# ordering loci by position
> gl5 <- gl5[,order(gl5$position)]
# ordering loc.metrics by position
> gl5$other$loc.metrics <- gl5$other$loc.metrics[order(gl5$other$loc.metrics$Position),]
# run the function with the ordered dataset

Please let us know if it worked for you.

Cheers,
Luis
